summary: Marqeta, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders held June 10, 2026. Proposals included election of four Class II directors, ratification of KPMG as auditor, approval of a 1-for-4 reverse stock split and authorized share reduction, officer exculpation, and advisory say-on-pay. All proposals passed. No special situation event is described; this is a routine meeting results filing.
